thread:
maya: heads-up — i iterated on a 'capacity rail' compact layout for dashboard tiles at 1200px. controls: min/max steppers, burst toggle (details), pool chip, SLO slider, live cost. concern: scanability and tab heaviness. proposal: condensed rail where burst details and pool metadata live in a popover; expand on click. also need explicit keyboard order and SR announcements.
jordan: i like the rail pattern. i'll mock condensed + expanded and include a tiny first-run hint so burst isn't missed. persist per-user preference. :art: 
liam: engineering notes: per-user preference is fine. popover needs focus trap, esc to return focus to burst toggle, and aria-controls/aria-expanded. SLO slider should update a polite aria-live region with the numeric value on change. watch stacking/overflow if card sits in a scrolling container.
sophia: product POV: default expanded for trial orgs, condensed for heavy accounts (heuristic: requests/day > 12k). copy: use "Burst (temp)" in tight spaces and full "Burst capacity (temporary)" in expanded view. helper under min/max: "Min/Max are targets; autoscale may briefly exceed." keep short for l10n.
alex: implementation tips: keep DOM order === tab order: min -> max -> burst -> pool -> slo -> cost. stepper buttons min hit 40px and add aria-labels like "increase min instances". Enter/Space toggles burst, Esc closes popover and returns focus. small CSS helper we reuse: ` .stepper button{min-width:40px;min-height:40px}`.
maya: action items: jordan to post mocks + a11y annotations; alex to add keyboard patterns to dev notes; liam to spike focus-trap and estimate; sophia to confirm threshold and final microcopy.
design-bot: created ticket <https://redwood.app/t/RED-5067|RED-5067> "Capacity rail: condensed pattern, SR readouts, keyboard flow" :white_check_mark:
jordan: will upload mocks by EOD and tag the thread. :thumbsup:
